ios.desc:
CAPTURE EVERY IDEA INSTANTLY
RecordMark is your AI-powered note taker for meetings, lectures, and interviews. Record clear audio and watch it transcribe live using Apple’s on-device speech recognition.

SMART AI SUMMARIES
Get instant AI-generated summaries and action points after every recording. Save hours reviewing notes and focus on what truly matters.

ANNOTATE, TAG, HIGHLIGHT AND ADD PHOTOS
Tap to highlight key moments, add notes, or attach photos. Every idea stays connected to its exact moment in your recording.

ORGANIZE WITH FOLDERS
Keep your recordings structured by project, class, or meeting. Easily search through audio, transcripts, and highlights.

EXPORT ANY WAY YOU WANT
Export as audio, text, or PDF. RecordMark’s powerful export options let you share summaries or full transcripts instantly.

PRIVATE AND FAST TRANSCRIPTION
Your recordings never leave your device. RecordMark uses Apple’s on-device AI to keep your data private and secure while delivering accurate, real-time transcription.

WHY USERS LOVE RECORDMARK
- AI note taker for meetings and lectures  
- Smart summaries and searchable transcripts  
- Add highlights, tags, and photos  
- Organize with folders  
- Export to PDF or audio  
- 100% on-device transcription for privacy

RecordMark helps you remember, summarize, and share your best ideas.

show_hn.title: Show HN: RecordMark – Annotate audio (pins, highlights, search)

quotes.text:
Hi HN! We built RecordMark to make voice notes easy to capture and easy to find later.

What’s different
• Drop pins while recording: text, tags, photos, highlights (time-stamped)
• Live transcription + a concise summary from the transcript on Home
• Zoomable waveform with auto-scrolling playhead and precise seek
• Search across audio, transcript, and annotations
• Folders to organize projects and move recordings
• Clean audio: clip guard, input gain, optional auto-split
• Flexible formats: WAV, M4A (AAC), MP3, CAF, AIFF

Why we made it
Most recorders help you capture, but not recall. RecordMark is built around recall: pin the moment, see words live, get a quick summary, and jump to the exact second.

Privacy
On-device by default. iCloud/Files export is optional. We don’t record phone calls.

Pricing
Free download. Pro unlock removes the time limit for long sessions.

Looking for feedback
— Anything rough or confusing?
— Which export formats/workflows do you use most?
— What should we optimize for meetings/interviews/lectures?

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/recordmark-annotate-audio/id6751431939
Support / Privacy / EULA links are in the app and on our support page.

Thanks for taking a look!
